AutixAI provides business automation and workflow integration services. The contracting party and any applicable registration, tax and billing details must be identified in the written proposal before a paid project begins.

Website information and examples

This site describes AutixAI’s services and possible workflows. Demos, example automation cards and calculator results are illustrative unless explicitly identified as a verified project. They are not customer testimonials, guaranteed savings, a promise of staffing reductions or a guarantee that every platform supports a connection. AI outputs need appropriate review.

Free audit and demo enquiries

The initial automation audit is a free conversation and assessment. It does not include implementation, software subscriptions or a reserved meeting time. Preparing a request creates a draft only; you decide whether to send it. AutixAI arranges demo calls personally unless a separate booking service is shown.

Paid work and clear costs

A paid project requires a separate written agreement identifying the contracting party, scope, deliverables, price, applicable taxes, payment milestones, timeline, acceptance, ownership, data access and support. Any change in scope or cost needs agreement before the additional work starts. Third-party subscriptions, AI usage, messaging fees, hosting and support must be identified as included or separate. This website has no checkout, automatic billing or paid subscription enrolment.

See Payments, Cancellation & Refunds. Cancellation and refund eligibility, any work already completed, committed third-party costs and the refund process must be agreed before payment. Nothing in these website notices removes rights that applicable law does not allow to be excluded.

Responsible use and access

Share only information you are authorised to provide. Do not submit passwords, keys, confidential records or children’s personal data in an initial enquiry or the guided assistant. Systems access, least-privilege permissions, human approval, testing and monitoring are agreed for the actual project. Do not use this website to interfere with other visitors, submit unlawful content or attempt unauthorised access.

Content, assets and third-party services

Website content and branding may be subject to intellectual-property rights. Font files are supplied under their included licences; those licences do not grant rights to AutixAI’s branding. Names of integration tools identify possible technologies, not endorsements or partnerships. WhatsApp, Instagram, booking providers and other platforms have their own terms and data practices. Availability, permissions, plans and features can change.

Questions, accessibility and updates

Contact us through +91 96173 10042 or WhatsApp. Read the Privacy Policy, Cookies & Privacy Choices and Accessibility page. We may update these website terms as the site changes; the date above identifies this version. Project agreements set the commercial terms of paid work.
